entities.name: Ernest Shackleton
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anglo-Irish Antarctic explorer (1874–1922) best known for the Endurance expedition (1914–1916), one of the greatest survival stories in exploration history. When his ship was crushed by pack ice, he led all 27 crew members to safety through an 800-mile open-boat journey across the Southern Ocean to South Georgia — losing not a single man.
